report:
MAP OF src/pages/network.js (read-only; numbers from the 6 fixtures via a temp jest file, now deleted)

STATE: contacts, mode (loading|saved|memory), stats, notice, busy; sourceFilter, directOnly, companyFilter (DEAD: no setter is ever called, no UI), graphSearch, groupBy ('role' default); focus {id,nonce} (where the camera was sent), viewId (bubble the globe reports you're in), lensFilter, selected; dashboard-only rankFilter, panelLens, panelQuery, panelSort, peopleShown; question/answer/asking/exampleIndex/askFocused; checks.

FLOW: contacts -> visibleContacts (source chips, directOnly, lensFilter, companyFilter) -> buildAtlas(visibleContacts,{groupBy}) (L663). Layers role>industry>company>person (atlas.js LAYERS). Any lens toggle rebuilds the whole atlas, so the globe re-lays out. highlightIds = people in visibleContacts matching graphSearch (substring of name/company/title) OR in the answer. NetworkGraph receives atlas, focus, viewId, highlightIds, selectedId. It has NO lensFilter prop: lenses work only by filtering the data. focus.nonce change -> fitNode flight; highlightIds change -> camera turns to the lit people; onViewNode -> setViewId as you pan. The dashboard (panel L747) = highlighted people if any are lit, else viewNode.contacts.

CONTROLS, WHAT THEY DO:
- Group radio (By role/company/industry/country): rebuilds the atlas, goes back to the root. Country is disabled with only a tooltip for LinkedIn files (no location).
- Find box "Find a person or company": highlights matches, the camera turns to them, the dashboard becomes "Highlighted matches". One letter lights nearly everyone.
- Source chips: only shown when there are 2+ sources.
- Breadcrumb (All › …) + "Drag to spin…" hint.
- Globe buttons: zoom +/-, Fit (same as Whole network/All), Full screen.
- "Zoom to" bar: the children of the current bubble (the same list as the dashboard's "Next layer" bars), plus a back chip.
- Presets: Whole network (clears lens + find, goes to root; does NOT clear the answer, groupBy, source chips or dashboard filters; shows as active even while an answer is lit). Raise/Source/Diligence = pickLens: filters the atlas and flies to a fixed group (LENS_GROUP: raise->investors, source->founders, diligence->experts) only when grouped by role. Largest company. "My direct connections only" (Attio firm contacts only).
- Dashboard: Layers steps (a third copy of the breadcrumb), seniority bar (click filters the list), three lens gauges (panelLens filters only the list, a second lens control with the same names as the presets), Next layer bars, "Filter these people", sort, Show more.
- Ask box: fixed EXAMPLES (L56), placeholder rotates every 3.5s, dropdown on focus. The answer renders at the BOTTOM of the page, below the 620px map. It lights people on the globe. Intro-path questions look up the company's investors on the server.
- Details panel (it replaces the dashboard): Company profile, Search company, Founder check, "Find intro paths to X".

LARGEST COMPANY: biggest = atlas.nodes.reduce over type 'company' nodes (L740). Under role and industry grouping, company nodes are per-branch slices (id g/role:founders/industry:Big Tech/c:google), so it picks the biggest slice, never the biggest company. On the VC fixture (544 people) it picks Google 12 although Stripe has 22 and Google 19. Stripe is split across groups. Founder fixture: Google 24 of 41. LP list: CalPERS 4 of 5. Sales CRM: Bayview Health System 13, while Marlowe Department Stores has 18. Only By company grouping gets it right. Why it can look like it does nothing: the click is only onNodeClick -> setSelected + goTo (a camera flight to a small depth-3 cluster, capped at 13px per person). There is no filter, no highlight and no active state, and the label never names the company (the name is only in the tooltip). If you are already there, or click it twice, nothing visibly changes. The only other change is the dashboard swapping to a details panel.

DEAD / BROKEN / MISLEADING / REDUNDANT:
1. "Remove all" calls setExpanded (L636), which is not defined anywhere. The ReferenceError fires after the data is already deleted and setContacts([]) has run, so the user gets an error notice for a delete that worked.
2. companyFilter: dead state.
3. Lens counts mean nothing. VC fixture: Source 499/544, Diligence 427/544. Founder fixture: Source 444/451. Every contact with any title or company gets diligence (roles.js fallback 'professional').
4. Zero-count presets stay pressable and show an empty map ("No contacts match these filters"): Raise capital 0 on the healthcare file, Diligence 0 on the LP list.
5. A lens flies to the wrong group. Diligence flies to Experts (65) while 427 people match. Source flies to Founders (200 of 499).
6. Tags are read as titles: classifyContact tests role.title against tags, but requireCompanyIf only checks the position. In sales-crm.csv the tag "partner" (69 rows, e.g. a department-store CEO) turns all 69 into "Investors & LPs" with Raise. So "Who can help me raise a fund?" returns retail executives.
7. The role groups and lenses are written for a VC. The LP list becomes one bubble ("Investors & LPs 114"), and its industry layer reads Investing 45, Venture capital 25. In the sales CRM the industry layer mixes in job functions (Finance & operations 64, Founders & CEOs 22, Sales & marketing 17), with Commerce only 19 although the file is retail ("Stores", "Grocers" and "Outfitters" don't match).
8. EXAMPLES are fixed: Google/Stripe are absent from 3 of the 6 files, and the questions assume fundraising.
9. Redundancy: 3 location indicators (breadcrumb, Layers steps, back chip), Zoom-to bar = Next layer bars, 2 lens controls, Fit = Whole network = All, 3 search inputs (ask, find, filter these people).
10. Lens preset counts use all contacts (roleCounts), while the globe and gauges use the filtered set.
11. DESIGN violations: hex colours inline (readableOn returns '#0F172A'/'#FFFFFF', fallbacks '#94A3B8' and '#64748B'), plus text-[10px] and other arbitrary sizes.

FIRST SCREEN AFTER AN UPLOAD, IN ORDER (importFile scrolls the page to the top):
1. Green notice: "Loaded 544 LinkedIn contacts into this tab." (or "Saved …").
2. Amber load error, if any.
3. Ask box with a rotating example placeholder.
4. "Founder checks you have run" (signed in, if any).
5. Sources card: "544 contacts · kept in this tab only", Remove all, the four connector cards again (Attio "soon").
6. Map toolbar: group radio, find box, "544 people · N companies".
7. Breadcrumb "All 544" + "Drag to spin · scroll to zoom · click to open".
8. The globe swinging in (2.6s), with legend "group / company, with a ray… / dark tip = leader".
9. Zoom to: the 4 role groups with counts.
10. Presets row.
11. Dashboard: Layers (Role "4 to pick", Industry —, Company —, People —), "Everyone you know 544", seniority bar 201/105/238, gauges Raise 132 / Source 499 / Diligence 427, Next layer bars, people list by seniority.
Nowhere does it say in words what is in the network or what to do next. The map sits below the ask box and the sources card.
facts: "Largest company" picks the largest company node in the atlas, and under role or industry grouping those nodes are per-branch slices, so on the VC fixture it flies to Google 12 while Stripe has 22 and Google 19 in all; only the By company grouping picks the true largest.

"Largest company" only moves the camera and opens a details panel: no filter, no highlight, no active state, and the button never names the company (only the tooltip does), so pressing it again or pressing it while already there changes nothing visible.
"Remove all" calls setExpanded (network.js L636), which does not exist: the delete succeeds but the user is shown an error notice.
Lens counts cannot discriminate: Source matches 499 of 544 on the VC file and 444 of 451 on the founder file, and Diligence is given to anyone with any title or company (roles.js fallback).

Tags are tested as titles in classifyContact while the generic-title guard checks only the position, so the CRM tag 'partner' turns 69 retail and healthcare executives in sales-crm.csv into Investors & LPs with the Raise lens.
Presets with a zero count stay pressable and empty the map ('No contacts match these filters'): Raise capital is 0 on the healthcare file and Diligence is 0 on the LP list.

Lens presets fly to a fixed role group (diligence to Experts 65 while 427 match; source to Founders 200 of 499), work only in role grouping, and rebuild the whole atlas because NetworkGraph has no lensFilter prop.
Example questions (Google, Stripe, raise a fund) are hard-coded in EXAMPLES at L56, and Google and Stripe appear in none of the sales, healthcare or LP files.

The page has duplicate controls: breadcrumb, Layers steps and back chip all show where you are; the Zoom-to bar repeats the dashboard's Next layer bars; there are two lens controls with the same names, three search inputs, and Fit, Whole network and All all reset the view.

After an upload the page scrolls to the top and shows a notice, the ask box and the four-card Sources section before the globe. The answer appears below the 620px map, and no sentence anywhere says what is in the network or what to do next.
